title: Advanced Conditionals
completion_message: ¡Sobresaliente! Has aprendido a usar condicionales avanzados invirtiendo el orden y omitiendo el 'if'. Esto da a tus negociaciones un tono extremadamente elegante y formal.

parts.visual:
En contextos muy formales y de negocios, podemos omitir 'If' invirtiendo el sujeto y el verbo auxiliar en los condicionales 1, 2 y 3. 
1er Condicional (Posibilidad): 'If you need help' -> SHOULD YOU NEED help. 
Ej: Should you need any further information, please contact us.
parts.audio: In very formal business contexts, we can omit 'If' by inverting the subject and the auxiliary verb in the first, second, and third conditionals. For the First Conditional, 'If you need help' becomes 'Should you need help'. For example: Should you need any further information, please contact us.

parts.visual:
2do Condicional (Hipotético): 'If we won the contract' -> WERE WE TO WIN the contract. 
Ej: Were we to win the contract, we would hire more staff. 
3er Condicional (Pasado irreal): 'If I had known' -> HAD I KNOWN. 
Ej: Had we known about the bug, we wouldn't have launched the software.
parts.audio: For the Second Conditional, 'If we won the contract' becomes 'Were we to win the contract'. For example: Were we to win the contract, we would hire more staff. For the Third Conditional, 'If I had known' becomes 'Had I known'. For example: Had we known about the bug, we wouldn't have launched the software.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma condicional avanzada correcta (sin usar 'If').

questions.question: ____ you have any questions, please do not hesitate to ask. (Si tiene alguna pregunta - formal).
questions.explanation: Should you have = If you have. Se usa en lenguaje muy formal (1er condicional).

questions.question: ____ I known the CEO was coming, I would have worn a tie. (Si hubiera sabido).
questions.explanation: Had I known = If I had known (3er condicional).

questions.question: ____ we to invest now, we would lose money. (Si invirtiéramos ahora - hipotético).
questions.explanation: Were we to invest = If we invested (2do condicional).

questions.question: ____ the client call, tell him I am in a meeting. (Si el cliente llama).
questions.explanation: Should the client call = If the client calls.

questions.question: ____ they offered a better price, we would have accepted. (Si hubieran ofrecido).
questions.explanation: Had they offered = If they had offered.

questions.question: ____ the server fail again, we will replace it. (Si llegara a fallar).
questions.explanation: Should the server fail = If the server fails.

questions.question: ____ he to resign, the stock price would plummet. (Si él renunciara).
questions.explanation: Were he to resign = If he resigned.

questions.question: ____ you need further assistance, please reply to this email. (Si necesitas).
questions.explanation: Should you need = If you need.

questions.question: ____ we acted sooner, we could have avoided the crisis. (Si hubiéramos actuado).
questions.explanation: Had we acted = If we had acted.

questions.question: ____ I in your position, I would accept the offer. (Si yo estuviera).
____ they not signed the contract, we would be in trouble now. (Si no hubieran firmado - mixto).
questions.explanation: Had they not signed = If they hadn't signed.

questions.question: ____ there be any delay, we will inform you immediately. (En caso de que haya).
questions.explanation: Should there be = If there is.

questions.question: ____ the market to crash, our investments would be safe. (Si el mercado cayera).
questions.explanation: Were the market to crash = If the market crashed.

questions.question: ____ I realized the microphone was on, I wouldn't have said that. (Si me hubiera dado cuenta).
questions.explanation: Had I realized = If I had realized.

questions.question: ____ you require a refund, please fill out this form. (Si requieres).
questions.explanation: Should you require = If you require.

questions.question: ____ she to accept the job, she would have to move to London. (Si ella aceptara).
questions.explanation: Were she to accept = If she accepted.

questions.question: ____ we not invested in marketing, sales would have dropped. (Si no hubiéramos invertido).
questions.explanation: Had we not invested = If we hadn't invested.

questions.question: ____ it rain tomorrow, the outdoor event will be cancelled. (En caso de que llueva).
questions.explanation: Should it rain = If it rains.

questions.question: ____ they to discover the error, we would be sued. (Si descubrieran).
questions.explanation: Were they to discover = If they discovered.

questions.question: ____ I been informed, I would have stopped the production. (Si hubiera sido informado).
questions.explanation: Had I been = If I had been.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el auxiliar correcto para formar el condicional invertido (Should, Were, Had).

questions.question: ____ you need help, call me. (Si necesitas - 1er)
____ I known, I would have helped. (Si hubiera sabido - 3er)
____ we to win, we would celebrate. (Si ganáramos - 2do)
____ the system fail, restart it. (Si falla)
____ they asked, we would have agreed. (Si hubieran preguntado)
____ she to resign, we would panic. (Si renunciara)
____ you have any questions, reply to this email. (Si tienes)
____ we acted earlier, we could have won. (Si hubiéramos actuado)
____ I in charge, I would fire him. (Si yo estuviera a cargo)
____ there be a delay, let me know. (En caso de que haya)

pairs.target: Si yo estuviera en tu lugar...
